nits: The regression test only goes through Walk; a direct Router.Routes() assertion, or a case for a method other than GET or a trailing-slash pattern (e.g. r.Post("/x/") next to Route("/x")), would also cover the other paths the fix changes.

report:
I found nothing the contributor needs to fix. The PR is ready to merge.

**Root cause:** `Mount()` (which `Route()` calls) registers a stub handler for every method on `/bar` and `/bar/`. `node.routes()` skipped any node that had a stub handler and no subroutes. So a later `r.Get("/bar", …)`, which replaces the GET handler on that same node, was dropped from `Routes()` and `Walk`. The fix adds a `stub` flag to each endpoint. `setEndpoint` sets it for Mount stubs and clears it when a method is registered directly. `routes()` now skips only the stub entries on such a node, not the whole node.

**Checks I ran:**
- `go test ./...` passes for both packages, and `go test -race .` passes.
- `go vet ./...` is clean, and `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- The new test `TestWalkRouteOnMountPattern` fails without the fix, so it does guard against the bug:
  ```
  tree_test.go:553: got [GET /foo/bar/{id} GET /foo/baz/{id}], want [GET /foo/bar GET /foo/bar/{id} GET /foo/baz/{id}]
  ```

**Edge cases:** I ran each router below through `Walk` and `Routes()` with and without the patch, and compared against what actually answers HTTP requests.

| Case | Before | After | Serves requests? |
|---|---|---|---|
| The issue's router | missing `GET /foo/bar` | reported | 200 |
| `r.Get("/bar")` registered **before** `Route("/bar")` | not reported | not reported | 404, since the mount overrides it, so leaving it out is correct |
| `Route("/x")` + `r.Method("DELETE","/x")` | missing | `DELETE /x` | 200 |
| `Route("/x")` + `r.Post("/x/")` | missing | `POST /x/` | 200 |
| `Route("/x")` + `r.Handle("/x", h)` (all methods) | missing | all methods on `/x` | 200 |
| `Mount("/x", plain handler)` + `r.Get("/x")` | missing | `GET /x` | 200 |
| `Mount("/x", plain handler)` only | — | same as before | — |
| `Mount("/x/", …)` + `r.Get("/x/")` | — | same as before | — |
| Plain `Route` + `Get` with no collision | — | same as before | — |

Each route that newly appears is one that actually serves requests. Routers without the collision produce exactly the same output as before. Nothing outside `tree.go` and `tree_test.go` changed, and there are no leftover files. I didn't treat the lack of a changelog entry as a problem, because `CHANGELOG.md` hasn't been updated per PR since v5.0.12 (2024).

I made the probe changes only in a temporary copy of the repo and deleted it afterwards. `git status` is as I found it.

```json
{"mergeable": true, "must_fix": [], "nits": ["The regression test only goes through Walk; a direct Router.Routes() assertion, or a case for a method other than GET or a trailing-slash pattern (e.g. r.Post(\"/x/\") next to Route(\"/x\")), would also cover the other paths the fix changes."]}
```
